name: Management Discussion and Analysis (GASB 34)
description: Required MD&A accompanying the financial statements in GASB 34 form, reviewed by the independent auditors.
preparedBy: Director of Business Services or designee
deadline: With the annual audited financial statements
quote: The Director of Business Services or designee shall be responsible for preparing the required Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) in the form required by GASB Statement 34.
